summary: The evaluation suite now measures the Nora that is deployed, through one function, rather than seven hand-built approximations of her.
details: nora/subject/obtain() composes the same dependency graph nora/__main__.py runs — same builder, same 40 fields — and there is no way for a caller to pass it a collaborator.

Three entry points are driven as the deployment drives them: the Relevance Gate's own decide, the fire path's speak, and Dispatcher.on_message, which is the call a platform adapter's listen loop makes.
Ten corpora (107 cases) moved across as data, checked field by field against the originals rather than retyped.

Eight of those ten were previously graded against a bare agent that had none of her context blocks, none of her tools and none of her output guards — so a number from them described a wording, never a room.
limitations: The old evaluation layer still runs and is still what a live number comes from; it is removed only once the replacement has driven a live run.
Three corpora — the two proactive suites and note candidates — have no entry point yet, and the judge and rubric graders have not moved across.

Two participation cases cannot run at all: they seed Honcho conclusions, which Honcho derives from messages rather than accepting, so there is no way to state one for a case without substituting the client. They report as errors rather than quietly grading as their own knowledge-cut twins.
